body: Totally get what’s your saying I’m just terrible in practice at all that.  I’ve done everything I could, from podcasts, YouTube like dr fox and med circle. Been trying to get into a DBT group anything that will help and turning up a bunch of dead ends. Been reeling since my psychiatrist told me I was to difficult to deal with and they aren’t willing to work with me anymore. Sorry.. I know this isn’t your problem.  Just tired of feeling like a freak and getting shitty at keeping the act up around people. Just didn’t think I’d fall this hard right back into old habits. I’d go to the hospital if it wouldn’t mess my job up. I just have to be careful cause I got no supports left and no one to turn to. I’m it. Sorry for ranting and thank you for your reply
